admission.justification: The rule binds three modules at once: the authoring methods build the record, the row producer says which row answers it, and the snapshot decides which bytes the anchor names, so a change in one without the others would record a value the code does not hold.

applicability: Every write of a weakness or a dependent through the leaf's admitted knowledge route.
conditions: The write runs against a resolved code tree; a confirmation write reads each stands_on link's value there and records the commit it read at.

A deferral-only write on an existing dependent omits confirmed, stands_on and document, updates only deferrals (recording condition.file blobs at the task's tip), raises revision and leaves stands_on and confirmed untouched.
Confirming a dependent with open deferrals is refused unless the same leaf edited the document; direct authoring of the deferrals field outside a crossing sync is refused.
exclusions: A document that stands on no code, which gets no record.
A second record for one document, which the writer refuses.

evidence: R4-verdict.md F01/F02/F04/F06/F07/F20 closures; the writer cases in mcp/tests/test_mik_r118_r124_marks.py

statement: The writer authors both kinds as it authors every record: a dependent confirmation reads each stands_on link value at the task's tip and refuses an unresolvable anchor or an unedited confirmation with open deferrals, while a deferral-only write (defer, redefer or lift on an existing dependent) updates deferrals and advances revision without touching stands_on or confirmed.
title: Dependent writes either confirm at tip or update deferrals without confirming
